properties.decision:
Recorded as BRAINSTORMING, not as a proposal. Triage of art:dev-reflow2-two-agent-exercise-feedback-2026-09-29, idea D7 (reflow2 half; flo2's half is in flo2's design). The source is a designer agent's friction log, on Anthony's exercise.

THE EVIDENCE: fact:root-cause-a-bulk-edge-form-was-offered-and-no-typed-helper-names-it-2026-09-29.
- About 270 single-edge calls in 3 rounds.
- ~75 of them (contain_component, allocate, provides, consumes) had a bulk route in create_edges that nothing pointed to.
- ~100 (constrains ~50, governed_by ~30, authored_by ~18) have per-type checks in their helpers (constrains_in's unit, basis and source; governed_by's ruling; authored_by's role-set normaliser) that create_edges' free `props` is not stated to apply.

OPTIONS, in the words of the report and the triage:
(a) NAME IT. Each typed helper built on create_edge says "for many, use create_edges" in its description. Cheap. Fixes discoverability for the ~75, and nothing for the rest.
(b) BULK THAT IS NOT A BYPASS. create_edges runs each edge type's helper check (a CONSTRAINS item gets constrains_in's unit comparison, a GOVERNED_BY item its ruling check, an AUTHORED_BY item the role-set normaliser), so bulk can never write what the typed helper would refuse. Medium: one dispatch table, and it closes a latent hole whatever else is chosen.
(c) LIST-TAKING HELPERS. constrains, governed_by and authored_by each take a list, like set_artifact_checksums. This generalises dec:idea-verifies-takes-a-list-of-targets. Medium, and it multiplies tool schemas.
(d) STRUCTURE BUNDLES. add_component takes contained_in / provides / consumes / allocated capabilities, and add_interface takes provided_by / consumed_by, drawn in the same all-or-nothing write. This is the structural sibling of req:the-mcp-surface-is-sized-for-tokens-per-task (c), which bundles only a requirement with its thread. Larger, and the most calls saved: a genesis structure step becomes one call per part.
(e) Nothing new: (c) BUNDLES in the requirement is enough.

COUNTER-ARGUMENTS, kept beside the options:
- dec:bulk-keeps-the-judgement-per-item: "a bulk form collapses the round trip, never the judgement". A structure bundle must still report each edge it drew, as a subject-first sentence, and each refusal. The echo drop in fact:root-cause-add-decision-discards-the-edge-echo-its-related-to-computed-2026-09-28 shows how easily an inline edge goes silent.
- dec:idea-prune-the-tool-surface-to-an-orthogonal-essential-set: (c) adds near-duplicate tools, and (a)/(b) add none.
- Constructors that draw edges inline are where the silent drop lives today (add_decision, add_capability), so (d) widens the surface that bug class lives on unless the shared "edges this call drew" reply block comes first.

A ranking is a finding, not a decision: (b) looks like a correctness fix whatever else is chosen; (a) is nearly free; (d) saves the most.
properties.name: OPEN — should every typed edge helper have a bulk form that KEEPS its own checks, and should a Component be written with its structural edges in one call? About 270 single-edge calls built one design through the flo2 connector
properties.rationale: The call count of building one design through a chat connector was measured for the first time, and it is dominated by single typed edges. A bulk form existed and was never found.
